pictures.name: SB1-Roadside-Inn
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. A dusty road across the plains of old Punjab at sunset. A welcoming roadside inn of mud brick with a courtyard, and beside it a small white Hindu temple with a little spire and a small mosque with a little dome, lamps glowing in both. Two travelers approach on foot: Guru Nanak, a figure in a long saffron-brown robe and a simple soft turban, seen only from behind or far away, his face never visible, and beside him Mardana, a lean Muslim musician of about forty with a short dark beard, a small cap and a plain white robe, carrying a rabab (a wooden lute). Long gold light, deep blue shadows.

pictures.name: SB2-The-Host
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. The lamp-lit courtyard of the roadside inn at dusk. The host, Sajjan, a well-fed man of about forty-five with a neat black beard, a rich maroon tunic and a cream turban, prayer beads around his wrist, smiles warmly and holds out a brass cup of water in welcome. Behind his smile, the corners of the courtyard sink into deep blue shadow where a locked wooden chest sits half hidden. The welcome feels a little too perfect.

pictures.name: SB3-Night-Song
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. Night inside a simple guest room of the inn, lit by one clay oil lamp. Mardana, a lean Muslim musician of about forty with a short dark beard, a small cap and a plain white robe, carrying a rabab (a wooden lute), sits playing his rabab, eyes closed. Beside him Guru Nanak, a figure in a long saffron-brown robe and a simple soft turban, seen only from behind or far away, his face never visible, sits singing, seen from behind. In the dark doorway, Sajjan, the man with the neat black beard, maroon tunic and cream turban, stands half in shadow, his face caught by the lamplight, frozen and listening.

pictures.name: SB5-Sajjan-Kneels
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. Dawn light through the inn’s doorway. Sajjan, the man with the neat black beard, maroon tunic and cream turban, kneels with his head bowed and his hands open, tears on his face, a wooden chest standing open beside him. Before him, Guru Nanak, a figure in a long saffron-brown robe and a simple soft turban, seen only from behind or far away, his face never visible, one hand gently raised in blessing. Soft gold light, forgiveness, relief.

pictures.name: SB6-Today-True-Words
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative oil painting in the same sacred style (lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light), a modern scene, main subject in the middle. No text, letters or logos. A small modern café table by a rainy window at evening. A young man in a hoodie, earnest and a little nervous, speaks honestly to his friend, a young Sikh woman in a cardigan with a steel kara on her wrist, who listens with kindness and her hand on the table near his. Two cups of tea, warm gold lamplight inside, blue rain outside. No phones, no text.
